name: cairn-headlamp-plugin
description: Cairn: a Ceph storage console for Rook clusters, as a Headlamp plugin

paths.name: @mui/material/Slider
paths.message: MUI Slider crashed Cairn under Headlamp's theme ("e.charAt is not a function"). Likely cause, not proven: MUI 5.18's Slider builds a variant for every theme palette key with a .main and runs decomposeColor on it, which throws when a .main is not a string. Use buttons, a select or a number field.
